notes: Direct fetch worked (HTTP 200, no WAF). Shopify store; per Rule 1, products_count was NOT trusted — every qty was independently verified by paging /collections/<handle>/products.json to exhaustion (limit=250) and deduping on product id. Nav menu (300+ links) fully enumerated via probe.py nav. Exclusions: Candles (candles handle, all scented wax candles = Home Fragrance), Dried Flowers + Fragrance (reed diffusers/dried florals), Furniture, Party Games, Artificial Flowers, Car Accessories, all of Kitchen menu (Cookware/Storage/Lunch Boxes/Casseroles/Kitchen Tools/Baking/Aprons — cookware/storage/appliances), Bar Tools, Cutlery, Fondue (cooking appliance), Water Bottles (personal hydration flasks, not tableware), Table Mats/Runners/Covers/Napkins/Napkin Rings (textile table linen), entire Bath menu (Bathroom Accessories/Sets dominated by functional soap/shampoo Dispensers; Organisers, Jewellery Boxes (mostly Makeup/Travel/Clothes Organiser storage, not decor), Floor Mats, Dustbins, Beauty Accessories — bathroom fixtures/storage/personal care), Bags, Jewellery, Soft Furnishing, Gifts/Stationery/DIY (Holiday & Gift), Kids collection (plushies/rugs/cushions, not decor), Luxe (curated cross-category rollup, not its own product type), Sale/New In/Bestsellers/Shop All rollup pages. Coasters and dressing-table-mirrors collections exist but return 0 products, dropped per project rule. Outdoor Planters (garden handle) and Devotion collections are mixed roll-ups on the site's own side; both were filtered down to their genuinely in-scope product_type subset (Planter only for Outdoor Planters; Devotion only for the idols/diyas/thalis category) rather than padded with the full raw collection count — see per-row evidence. Duplicate-company check: Nestasia is an independent Indian D2C decor/tableware retailer (est. Kolkata), not a private-label storefront of, or affiliated with, any other company processed in this project (Cello World, Pepperfry, Myntra Home, etc. are unrelated distinct entities) — no duplicate found.
